Opens a path into a ~$5.7B reference market in hemophilia A.
Sandoz gets exclusive rights ex-3 countries
Leverages Sandoz’s global reach; defines geography for revenue split.
Positions mAbxience for manufacturing-driven revenue streams.
Limits visibility on deal economics and margin impact.

This is an early-stage strategic expansion into rare-disease biosimilars, aligned with upcoming biologic LOEs. A larger catalyst would be positive clinical data, regulatory filings/approvals, or disclosed economics guiding revenue timing and scale.
